evidencePath.mapDrivesHierarchy: Source lock on city / neighborhood / community / subdivision. Atlas regions (and GIS ring on plats) drive child places. No getIndexableSubdivisions dump. No "Subdivisions in …" heading above neighborhood bars. Held by ci:place-craft and by --ship.

competitorFirstLook.peer: Named peer — Redfin or a Bend competitor place page. Placeholder "competitor" / "peer" / "tbd" is refuse.

competitorFirstLook.shots: side-by-side image, OR sequential ours + peer images (or shots.sequence of 2+). Files must exist on disk. One lonely house shot is refuse.
